Full summary: Phase 2 shipped (plugin 1.19.0 + npm-side prep for 2.3.0): esbuild dep-free single-file server bundle (scripts/build-plugin-bundle.mjs; keyless/deterministic; 1.27MB; committed at plugin/server/twining-server.mjs + published as dist/server.bundle.mjs), __TWINING_VERSION__ baking with runtime fallback, launcher ladder now override → pin → npx → npm-prefix → global → bundled(node>=22.13) → diagnostic, CI plugin-bundle-freshness job (keyless) + publish dist-only keyed bundle step + bump-script integration, docs. Full suite 1256 passed. Also verified cmux --worktree empirically: connection fixed, store divergence remains (separate finding posted).
Decisions: Chose a major.minor node gate (>= 22.13) for the bundled rung over the reviewer-flagged major-only >= 22 — node:sqlite landed in 22.5 and engines demands 22.13; a major-only gate would let 22.0-22.12 silently degrade to the files backend, diverging from the npx rung's engines enforcement.; Chose file-existence cascade for a dangling TWINING_SERVER_JS override over fail-loud exec — keeps --probe and launch in agreement (the probe-says-healthy-but-launch-dies pattern is the exact bug class this work eliminates); a dev debugging an override can still see the cascade in --probe output.; Chose the npm version lifecycle hook (build:plugin + git add plugin/server) to prevent the release-flow trap where a package.json version bump strands a stale committed bundle — caveat recorded: manual package.json edits bypass it, so releases must use npm version or run build:plugin explicitly.; Chose NOT to fix the probe-cwd-skew nit (a profile that cd's can change where the pin rung's ./node_modules resolves during the hook's login-shell probe vs launch) — anchoring probe cwd via CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is plausible but touches the hook's probe invocation after tests went green, for an edge case requiring a cd in a profile plus a project pin; recorded as decision-not-taken.; Chose to deliver the cmux worktree store-divergence fix as a recommendation rather than implement it now — worktree-aware resolveProjectRoot changes store-resolution semantics and raises an unsettled design question (shared record sentinel across teammates could let one teammate's record satisfy another's commit gate); flagged for Dave with effort estimate rather than decided unilaterally.
